newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen adding reserves via 3-day system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen adding reserves via 3-day system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve is likely to add temporary reserves to the banking system on Monday via three-day system repurchase agreements, analysts said.
"There's an add need of $4.0 billion to $5.0 billion in the remainder of the (bank reserve maintenance) period this Wednesday," said James Glassman, senior economist at Chase Securities Inc.
Glassman said "the window is also open" for a coupon pass, a permanent addition of reserves to the banking system.
"People are debating whether it happens before or after Thanksgiving," he said.
"The reserve need can justify doing a coupon pass at any time," said Glassman. "It's something that could happen as early as later this week," said Glassman.
At 1121 EST/1621 GMT, the federal funds rate was quoted at 5-5/16 percent, slightly higher than the central bank's 5-1/2 percent target for the rate.
